newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Minsur started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Minsur started as buy.

text.p: -- Santander Investment said on Tuesday it had started Peru's Minsur S.A. with a buy rating.

-- In a report headlined "Win With Tin," analyst Victoria Santaella wrote that she expected Minsur, the fourth-largest tin producer in the world, to report earnings per share of $0.63 in 1996, $1.04 in 1997 and $1.14 in 1998.
-- "The 12- to 18-month target price of 33.30 soles implies a 32-percent upside in U.S. dollar terms," she wrote.
-- The company's shares were trading at 23.50 soles on Tuesday.
